def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    srows=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==8 for x in g[r])]
    scols=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==8 for r in range(H))]
    rb=bands(srows,H); cb=bands(scols,W)
    pos=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] in (2,3): pos[g[r][c]].append((r,c))
    o=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for col,cells in pos.items():
        cells=sorted(cells)
        rows=sorted(set(r for r,_ in cells)); cols=sorted(set(c for _,c in cells))
        rmin,rmax=rows[0],rows[-1]; cmin,cmax=cols[0],cols[-1]
        # vertical fill: rowband of each marker column? no: marker spans between two colors along a line; here markers on opposite sides of center

        for r in range(rmin,rmax+1):
            for c in range(cmin,cmax+1):
                o[r][c]=col
        # intersections: cells where both 2-rect and 3-rect meet get 6? check
    return o
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==8 for x in g[r])]
    sc=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r_][c]==8 for r_ in range(H))]
    rb=bands(sr,H); cb=bands(sc,W)
    def bid(v,b): return next(i for i,(a,bx) in enumerate(b) if a<=v<=bx)
    o=[[g[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    F={}
    for col in (2,3):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==col]
        rmin=min(r for r,_ in cells); rmax=max(r for r,_ in cells)
        cmin=min(c for _,c in cells); cmax=max(c for _,c in cells)
        R=[i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(rb) if a<=rmax and b>=rmin]
        C=[j for j,(a,b) in enumerate(cb) if a<=cmax and b>=cmin]
        F[col]=(set(R),set(C))
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            rbi=bid(r,rb); cbi=bid(c,cb)
            f2 = rbi in F[2][0] and cbi in F[2][1]
            f3 = rbi in F[3][0] and cbi in F[3][1]
            if f2 and f3: o[r][c]=6
            elif f2 and g[r][c]!=2: o[r][c]=2

    return o

def solve(g):

    sr=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==8 for x in g[r])]
    sc=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==8 for r in range(H))]
    rb=bands(sr,H); cb=bands(sc,W)
    def bid(v,bds): return next(i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(bds) if a<=v<=b)
    o=[[g[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    for col in (2,3):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==col]
        if not cells: continue
        rmin=min(r for r,_ in cells); rmax=max(r for r,_ in cells)
        cmin=min(c for _,c in cells); cmax=max(c for _,c in cells)
        # contiguous band range between band of rmin and band of rmax (same for cols)
        rlo=bid(rmin,rb); rhi=bid(rmax,rb)
        clo=bid(cmin,cb); chi=bid(cmax,cb)
        R=set(range(rlo,rhi+1)); C=set(range(clo,chi+1))
        for r in range(H):
            if r in sr: continue
            for c in range(W):
                if c in sc: continue
                if r in R and c in C and g[r][c]!=col: o[r][c]=col
        # mark intersections of the two colors' boxes -> 6
    inter=set()
    for col in (2,3):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==col]
        rmin=min(r for r,_ in cells); rmax=max(r for r,_ in cells)
        cmin=min(c for _,c in cells); cmax=max(c for _,c in cells)
        rlo=bid(rmin,rb); rhi=bid(rmax,rb); clo=bid(cmin,cb); chi=bid(cmax,cb)
        R=set(range(rlo,rhi+1)); C=set(range(clo,chi+1))
        other={c2 for c2 in (2,3) if c2!=col}
        for c2 in other:
            o2=[r for r in range(H) if g[r][c2]==c2]
            rmin2=min(o2); rmax2=max(o2)
            cmin2=min(c for r,c in zip(o2,[c for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==c2]))
            cmax2=max(c for r,c in zip(o2,[c for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==c2]))
            rlo2=bid(rmin2,rb); rhi2=bid(rmax2,rb); clo2=bid(cmin2,cb); chi2=bid(cmax2,cb)
            R2=set(range(rlo2,rhi2+1)); C2=set(range(clo2,chi2+1))
            inter |= {(r,c) for r in R & R2 for c in C & C2}
    for r,c in inter: o[r][c]=6
    return o

def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==8 for x in g[r])]
    sc=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==8 for r in range(H))]
    rb=bands(sr,H); cb=bands(sc,W)
    def bid(v,bds): return next(i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(bds) if a<=v<=b)
    o=[[g[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    bboxes=[]
    for col in (2,3):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==col]
        rmin,rmax=min(r for r,_ in cells),max(r for r,_ in cells)
        cmin,cmax=min(c for _,c in cells),max(c for _,c in cells)
        lo_r,hi_r=min(bid(rmin,rb),bid(rmax,rb)),max(bid(rmin,rb),bid(rmax,rb))
        lo_c,hi_c=min(bid(cmin,cb),bid(cmax,cb)),max(bid(cmin,cb),bid(cmax,cb))
        bboxes.append((col,lo_r,hi_r,lo_c,hi_c))
    # paint boxes (markers already colored, fine)
    for col,r0,r1,c0,c1 in bboxes:

def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==8 for x in g[r])]
    sc=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==8 for r in range(H))]
    rb=bands(sr,H); cb=bands(sc,W)
    def bid(v,bds): return next(i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(bds) if a<=v<=b)
    o=[[g[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    bboxes=[]
    for col in (2,3):
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==col]
        if len(cells)!=2: continue
        rmin,rmax=min(r for r,_ in cells),max(r for r,_ in cells)
        cmin,cmax=min(c for _,c in cells),max(c for _,c in cells)
        r0,r1=min(bid(rmin,rb),bid(rmax,rb)),max(bid(rmin,rb),bid(rmax,rb))
        c0,c1=min(bid(cmin,cb),bid(cmax,cb)),max(bid(cmin,cb),bid(cmax,cb))
        bboxes.append((col,r0,r1,c0,c1))
    # paint each bbox fully across its band ranges (rows 0..H-1 not separators; cols 0..W-1 not separators)
    for col,r0,r1,c0,c1 in bboxes:
        for r in range(H):
            if r in sr or r<r0 or r>r1: continue
            for c in range(W):
                if c in sc or c<c0 or c>c1: continue
                o[r][c]=col
    res=[row[:] for row in o]
    n=len(bboxes)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1,n):
            for r in range(max(bboxes[i][1],bboxes[j][1]), min(bboxes[i][2],bboxes[j][2])+1):
                if r in sr: continue
                for c in range(max(bboxes[i][3],bboxes[j][3]), min(bboxes[i][4],bboxes[j][4])+1):
                    if c in sc: continue
                    res[r][c]=6
    return res
